definitions.gloss: service industry, hospitality work, customer-facing job
definitions.explanation: Work that involves directly serving and interacting with customers, such as retail, food service, hotels, and similar customer-facing occupations.

examples.japanese: {接客業|せっきゃくぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have experience in the service industry.

examples.japanese: {接客業|せっきゃくぎょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧。
examples.english: Service industry jobs are suited for people who like talking to others.

examples.japanese: {接客業|せっきゃくぎょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧な{言葉遣|ことばづか}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: In the hospitality industry, a smile and polite language are expected.

notes:
USAGE:
A common term in job listings and career discussions. Covers a wide range of customer-facing work including restaurants, retail stores, hotels, and beauty salons.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {接客業|せっきゃくぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧ (service industry experience)
- {接客業|せっきゃくぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧ (to work in the service industry)
- {接客業|せっきゃくぎょう}⟦{向|む}き→向き：12041_muki⟧ (suited for service work)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦サービス{業|ぎょう}→サービス業：25287_saabisugyou⟧: service industry — broader, includes non-customer-facing services
- ⟦{接客|せっきゃく}→接客：12882_sekkyaku⟧: customer service — the act of serving customers, not the industry itself
